{'text': '由於 iPhone Duo 為 iPhone 系列帶來截然不同嘅外觀，你都需要為佢專門設計嘅配件。BMX 專門圍繞 iPhone Duo 打造咗 SolidSafe Duo，設計上可以完美貼合機背而不會超出邊緣，並且附帶支架。', 'paragraph_context': 'With the iPhone Duo bringing an entirely different shape to the iPhone lineup, you’ll need accessories built for it as well. BMX built the SolidSafe Duo specifically around the iPhone Duo. It’s designed to fit perfectly on the back without bleeding over and includes a stand.'}

{'text': 'MagSafe 星期一專欄：每逢星期一，Bradley Chambers 都會探討 MagSafe 同無線充電行業嘅最新動向，幫你充分發揮支援無線充電嘅 Apple 裝置嘅效能。', 'paragraph_context': 'MagSafe Monday: Every Monday, Bradley Chambers looks at the latest and greatest in the MagSafe and wireless charging industry to help you get the most out of your Apple devices that support wireless charging.'}

{'text': 'SolidSafe Duo 能夠切合 iPhone Duo 嘅比例，關鍵在於電池芯本身。喺呢款 MagSafe 電池入面，BMX 採用咗特製嘅 5,000mAh 半固態電池芯，而唔係傳統鋰離子電池芯，令佢哋可以靈活地設計出配合 iPhone Duo 特定尺寸嘅小巧外型。標準電池芯如果唔係令電池超出邊緣，就必須大幅犧牲容量，兩者難以兼得。', 'paragraph_context': 'The reason the SolidSafe Duo fits the iPhone Duo’s proportions is the battery cell itself. In this MagSafe battery, BMX used a custom-made 5,000mAh semi-solid-state cell rather than a standard lithium-ion cell, which gave them the flexibility to build a compact form factor built for the iPhone Duo’s specific dimensions. A standard battery cell wouldn’t have allowed that without the battery overhanging the edges or sacrificing too much on the capacity.'}

{'text': '半固態電池所含嘅液態電解質遠少於傳統鋰離子電池。液體減少意味住電池內部可燃物料更少，從而降低因高溫、物理損壞或內部短路引發火災嘅風險。大家都睇過唔少電池回收個案，自然明白呢點有多重要。', 'paragraph_context': 'The semi-solid-state battery contains significantly less liquid electrolyte than conventional lithium-ion batteries. With less liquid, there is less flammable material inside the cell, which reduces the fire risk associated with heat, physical damage, or internal short circuits. We’ve all seen enough battery recalls to understand why this is important.'}

{'text': '360 度旋轉支架', 'paragraph_context': 'The 360-degree stand'}

{'text': '呢個一體式旋轉指環支架係根據用戶使用 iPhone Duo 嘅方式而設計。直向模式適合閱讀同 iMessage 傳訊息，橫向模式適合睇片，半摺模式就適合免提通話。支架可以 360 度旋轉，而且當你改變手機姿態時都會保持貼附，唔使每次轉換揸機方式都要除低充電寶。', 'paragraph_context': 'The integrated rotating ring stand is designed around how people will use the iPhone Duo. Portrait mode is for reading and iMessage, and landscape for video, partially folded for hands-free calls. The stand rotates 360 degrees and stays attached as the phone’s position changes, so you don’t have to remove the battery pack every time you shift how you’re holding the iPhone Duo.'}

{'text': '充電速度同內置線材', 'paragraph_context': 'Charging speeds and the built-in cable'}

{'text': 'SolidSafe Duo 電池可以透過 MagSafe 以高達 15 瓦嘅功率為你嘅 iPhone Duo 充電，亦可透過附帶嘅 USB-C 掛繩線以高達 20 瓦嘅功率充電。條線同充電寶一體化，意味住你唔使額外帶備或擔心遺失獨立嘅充電線。佢亦可透過同一條線以高達 15 瓦嘅輸入功率為電池本身充電。', 'paragraph_context': 'The SolidSafe Duo battery charges your iPhone Duo at up to 15 watts per MagSafe or up to 20 watts through the attached USB-C lanyard cable. The cable stays with the power bank, which means no separate charging cable to pack or lose track of. It also handles input of up to 15 watts via that same cable to recharge it.'}

{'text': '電池上嘅全彩 LCD 螢幕可以同時顯示剩餘電量同即時充電瓦數，等你一眼睇清楚仲有幾多電可用，以及實際充電速度有幾快。', 'paragraph_context': 'A full-color LCD on the battery displays remaining battery capacity and live charging wattage simultaneously, so you can see both how much power you have left and how fast it’s actually charging.'}

{'text': 'SolidSafe Duo 電池總結', 'paragraph_context': 'Wrap up on the SolidSafe Duo battery'}

{'text': 'SolidSafe Duo 嘅定價比起一般通用或者平價 MagSafe 電池略高，但既然你用緊 iPhone Duo，自然想用為佢專門設計嘅配件以發揮最大價值，所以值得考慮一下。雖然未來幾個月好大機會有更平嘅電池推出，不過如果你喺開賣初期就想買到一款，呢款睇落係個穩陣嘅選擇。', 'paragraph_context': 'The SolidSafe Duo is priced at a premium over generic/budget MagSafe battery packs, but with the iPhone Duo, you’ll want to have accessories designed specifically for it to maximize its value, so it’s worth a look. It’s likely that less expensive batteries will be launched in the coming months, but if you want one at launch, this looks like a solid option.'}

{'text': '你可以到 Amazon 或者直接從 BMX 買到呢款全新嘅 SolidSafe Duo。', 'paragraph_context': 'You can pick up the new SolidSafe Duo from Amazon or directly from BMX.'}
